resumeText:
ALEX CHEN
alex.chen@example.com | 0400 000 000 | linkedin.com/in/alex-chen-example

SUMMARY
Passionate, hard-working team player with a strong desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment.

SKILLS
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, Git, HTML, CSS

EXPERIENCE
Frontend Developer Intern — Brightline Digital, Melbourne (02/2025 – 07/2025)
- Built the booking form for a physiotherapy clinic's website in React and TypeScript, with validation that cut incomplete submissions.
- Wrote unit tests for the form with Jest and React Testing Library.
- Worked with the designer to turn Figma mock-ups into reusable components.

Kitchen Hand — Harbour Cafe, Melbourne (06/2023 – 01/2025)
- Prepared food and kept the kitchen clean during busy weekend shifts.

PROJECTS
Recipe Finder — React, TypeScript
Search recipes by ingredient using a public recipes API, with saved favourites stored in local storage.

Budget Tracker — React, Node.js, MongoDB
Track spending by category with monthly charts; users sign in and their data is kept per account.

EDUCATION
Master of Information Technology — Monash University (2023 – 2024)
Bachelor of Science (Mathematics) — National Taiwan University (2017 – 2021)
